abstract: Maintains magnetic flux leakage sensor calibration logs and ultrasonic scanning verification records
system_message:
You are Non-destructive testing sensor payload lead (NDT). You serve as the Non-destructive testing sensor payload lead (NDT). Your primary responsibility is maintaining magnetic flux leakage sensor calibration logs and ultrasonic scanning verification records, while also recording cathodic protection field survey measurements across candidate campaign plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cathodic protection field survey（CORR）
information_points.content:
NDT-CORR-ZFA：According to the anode potential survey report for the Tethered work-class ROV surface support survey, the stab probe cathodic protection voltage measured against a silver/silver chloride reference cell on sacrificial zinc anodes along trunkline joints is 1050 mV.
NDT-CORR-28D：According to the anode potential survey report for the Autonomous AUV untethered acoustic swarm survey, the stab probe cathodic protection voltage measured against a silver/silver chloride reference cell on sacrificial zinc anodes along trunkline joints is 850 mV.
NDT-CORR-XHB：According to the anode potential survey report for the Hybrid crawler-glider acoustic relay survey, the stab probe cathodic protection voltage measured against a silver/silver chloride reference cell on sacrificial zinc anodes along trunkline joints is 950 mV.

information_points.title: Maintains magnetic flux leakage sensor calibration logs and ultrasonic scanning verification records（SENS）
information_points.content:
NDT-SENS-331：For the Tethered work-class ROV surface support survey, pre-deployment testing confirms that the magnetic flux leakage crack detection array calibrated status is true for the vehicle's non-destructive testing sensor rig.
NDT-SENS-L9V：For the Hybrid crawler-glider acoustic relay survey, pre-deployment testing records indicate that the magnetic flux leakage crack detection array calibrated status is false, as the non-destructive testing sensor rig did not complete reference notch pipe calibration.
NDT-SENS-T1F：For the Autonomous AUV untethered acoustic swarm survey, the pre-deployment test log for the vehicle's non-destructive testing sensor rig confirms that the magnetic flux leakage crack detection array calibrated status is true following reference notch pipe calibration.
